decision: TMT (OAD CCR34 + Open-MBEE TMT-SysML-Model) checked after the author chose to extend the task to TMT; not admissible
rationale: Verification before building a protocol v2 task: (1) the OAD defines each REQ-1-OAD requirement in place; the 128 unbracketed ID mentions are rows of budget/parameter tables, not cross-references, so there is no requirement-architecture integration across distant sections; (2) the model holds 1,949 imported requirement elements (TMT_Requirement/ReqIF) but only 13 satisfy/allocate/refine/verify relations touch blocks, all APS level-2, so no model-side subsystem allocation GT exists for OAD requirements; (3) the 582 REQ-2-APS -> REQ-1-OAD refines links would require the APS DRD, which is not public (tracetree.tmt.org). A requirement-to-subsystem placement task on TMT would be a heading lookup inside one document with GT taken from the document itself, which does not test the method and does not meet the reviewer-free model-document alignment rule. No protocol v2 written; no LLM calls made.

decision: Post-hoc, descriptive precision decomposition of Rubin outputs (scripts/precision_rubin.py; experiments/outputs/rubin-precision.json; no model call; scorer and GT unchanged). Output pairs were classified against a lenient parse of LDM-148 15.2 in the model input (1,471 listed pairs; 1,174 of the 1,187 GT pairs). Of the scorer-spurious pairs (555-582 per run in the chunk arms), about half are allocations the document does state but that lie outside GT scope (interface-requirement ids such as OCS-DM-COM-ICD-xxxx and suffixed variants; 285/290 per run), and the other half are component misattributions (268/283 per run), 97.9% of which (1,619 of 1,654) go to the neighbouring component in 15.2 order: the chunk-breadcrumb failure noted in ACCESS-047. Document precision Sol/Opus: B1 = B2 = M 0.822/0.825 (they share the chunk extraction stage), M2R 0.844/0.848 (misattributions go to the appendix heading), B0 and B0-mem 1.000 at low recall. Scope precision (DMSR ids only): M 0.818/0.808, M2R 0.879/0.866, B0 1.000. Open PCA: the 11 spurious pairs per run are identical in every arm (the section "Labeling of Nonfunctional Requirements" treated as a component), so no arm comparison is affected.
rationale: Report precision next to recall for Rubin; state the breadcrumb failure as a method limitation of all chunk arms; a fix is a method change and must be pre-specified before any new document.
